briefing: Trial at the Marble Edge. Marble Law, Iron Oath: Trial Terms: optional objectives change rewards but never overwrite faction identity.

missionIntro.speaker: Asgardian Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The oath is not decoration. It is the weight we choose to carry.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: The field answers courage with pressure; every vow spoken here leaves a mark in iron.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Take the hit only if the counterstroke matters. Valhalla rewards committed timing, not noise.

victory.speaker: Asgardian Divine Voice
victory.text: The bridge remembers we stood. Let the Gate choke on that memory.

defeat.speaker: Asgardian Divine Voice
defeat.text: Fall back. An oath wasted is a weapon handed to the wound.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Marble Law, Iron Oath records how Asgardian law treats courage as responsibility, not fuel for the Gate.
